$comment: Flag facts. Each value is a DESCRIPTION, not just a name, so tpl.flag-describe.mc4 can test the same fact without sight — a screen-reader user ends up with an identical user_facts row. Every fact here is `stable`, and that is graded rather than unfilled: a national flag changes on a scale of decades, and none of these 65 has changed since the pack was authored. The two-year re-verification window is the right one. Reviewed 2026-08-05.
